title: ROSE II: Pilot Study to Analyze Menstrual Blood to Predict Endometriosis
mf_relevance: Menstrual blood is analyzed to develop a non-invasive endometriosis screening/diagnostic algorithm
notes: Registry protocol describes prospective menstrual-blood scRNA-seq and repeated-cycle reproducibility work.

title: Evolution and Genetic Basis of Menstruation in Women
mf_relevance: Non-invasive menstrual-fluid collection for gene-expression and regulatory profiling
notes: EVOMENS; linked to a curated MFOX publication where the relationship is explicitly reported.

title: Vaginal Microbiome and IVF Pregnancy Outcome
mf_relevance: Menstrual effluent is an optional collected sample for complementary reproductive-tract biomarker information
notes: Registry explicitly lists menstrual effluent as optional alongside vaginal and blood samples.

title: Endometrial Mediators of Gonadal Steroid Action
mf_relevance: Protocol collected endometrium and/or menstrual effluent for hormone-responsive molecular studies
notes: Historical tissue-collection protocol; menstrual effluent was obtained with an intravaginal collection device in some participants.

title: Exploring and Validating Biomarkers in Menstrual Blood
mf_relevance: Menstrual blood is compared with venous blood and other reproductive samples for biomarker utility
notes: Menstrual cup collection; registry record is focused on fertility and biomarker validation.

title: Vaginal Sildenafil for Primary Dysmenorrhea
mf_relevance: Menstrual effluent samples are collected during a mechanistic dysmenorrhea intervention study
notes: Registry explicitly states menstrual effluent collection; the primary mechanistic outcome is uterine contractility by MRI.

title: Pain in Endometriosis And the Relation to Lifestyle (PEARL)
mf_relevance: Menstrual effluent is collected to measure inflammatory and immune characteristics, epigenetic features and intervention-associated changes.
notes: PEARL. Also registered in the Netherlands public human-research registry.

title: Anti-Inflammatory Diet in Endometriosis (AIDEN) study
mf_relevance: Participants collected menstrual effluent to study inflammatory characteristics alongside serum, vaginal microbiome and gut microbiome during an anti-inflammatory diet intervention.
notes: Public Dutch human-research registry record (ToetsingOnline / Onderzoek met mensen).

title: The Investigation of Vitamin D and Menstrual Cycles Trial (inVitD)
sponsor: National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences (NIEHS)
technology: Vitamin D metabolite assays; stromal-cell decidualization
mf_relevance: A subset collected menstrual effluent before and after cholecalciferol supplementation; menstrual-fluid vitamin D metabolites and derived stromal-cell decidualization were studied.
notes: Menstrual-effluent use is documented in the linked 2026 publication and trial-derived methods.

title: MetriDx Test Proof-of-Concept Study for Endometriosis Biomarkers
mf_relevance: The protocol specifies menstrual-effluent collection and analysis with the MetriDx assay alongside tissue-based diagnostic assessment.
notes: The public summary emphasizes uterine biopsy; the posted protocol explicitly describes menstrual-effluent sample analysis.

title: Reframing Endometrial Physiology by Advanced Integrated Research (REPAIR)
sponsor: University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust
technology: Molecular biomarker profiling; cine MRI; wearable electrophysiology
mf_relevance: Menstrual effluent collected during menstruation is analyzed for molecular biomarkers alongside endometrial biopsy, vaginal swabs, blood, MRI and wearable physiology.
notes: REPAIR integrates menstrual-fluid biomarkers with functional uterine physiology and imaging in heavy menstrual bleeding.

title: Can the levels of a cell signalling factor in menstrual blood be used as a test for endometriosis?
sponsor: Sriwijaya University / Dr Mohammad Hoesin General Hospital
mf_relevance: Menstrual blood TGF-β1 was measured as a candidate diagnostic marker for endometriosis.
notes: Retrospectively registered; published results are available.

title: AI-Driven Analysis of Menstrual Blood: Diagnosing Endometriosis through Image Processing
sponsor: LMU Klinikum, Institute for Infectious and Tropical Medicine
mf_relevance: Participants contribute menstrual-blood images for development and validation of machine-learning models for potential endometriosis diagnosis.
notes: MAI (Menstrual Blood AI); prospective DRKS registration.

title: Diagnostic and Prognostic Markers of Endometriosis in Menstrual Blood (MultiMENDo)
mf_relevance: Repeated menstrual-blood sampling is used to identify diagnostic, prognostic and treatment-response biomarkers in endometriosis.
notes: Clinical registry record associated with the MultiMENDo research program.

title: Menstrual Blood Proteomic Profile in Women With Endometriosis (PROTEO-ENDO)
mf_relevance: Menstrual blood is self-collected and profiled by proteomics to identify disease-associated proteins and subtype/stage differences.
notes: PROTEO-ENDO.

title: Multicenter Diagnostic Validation of a Menstrual-Blood Laboratory Test for Endometriosis
mf_relevance: Self-collected menstrual blood is used to validate a laboratory biomarker test against confirmed endometriosis and control cohorts.
notes: Industry-sponsored diagnostic validation study by Diamens FlexCo.

title: MEN-ENDO: Menstrual Stem Cells in Endometriosis
sponsor: Universitat Rovira i Virgili / Hospital Universitari Joan XXIII
technology: Cell culture; functional assays; immune profiling; molecular profiling
mf_relevance: Menstrual blood-derived stem cells and the immune environment are compared between endometriosis and control participants.
notes: MEN-ENDO.

title: Autologous Decidual-like NK Cells Therapy for Reproductive Failure Associated with Abnormal Uterine Natural Killer Cells
condition: Reproductive failure associated with abnormal menstrual-blood NK cells
sponsor: Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital, Affiliated Hospital of Medical School, Nanjing University
mf_relevance: Menstrual blood NK-cell abnormalities are used to identify the target reproductive-failure population and menstrual blood is collected as a study biospecimen.
notes: Prospectively registered ChiCTR multicenter trial; menstrual blood is explicitly collected and menstrual-blood NK-cell improvement is a secondary outcome.

title: Autologous Menstrual Blood Stem Cells for Infertility Caused by Moderate or Severe Intrauterine Adhesion
condition: Infertility caused by moderate/severe intrauterine adhesions
mf_relevance: Autologous menstrual blood-derived stem cells are the therapeutic product used to treat infertility associated with intrauterine adhesions.
notes: ChiCTR record explicitly lists menstrual blood as a collected human specimen and the source of the autologous stem-cell therapy.

title: Phase II Study of Menstrual Blood-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells (SC01009) for Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
mf_relevance: The investigational cell product SC01009 is derived from menstrual blood and is being evaluated as a systemic cell therapy.
notes: ChiCTR phase II record; included to represent translational utilization of menstrual-blood-derived cells beyond gynecology.

title: Influence of Lemon on the Inflammatory Activity of Healthy Women During Menstruation
mf_relevance: Menstrual fluid was collected on day 2 and analyzed for prostaglandins, inflammatory cytokines and related proteins alongside peripheral blood.
notes: ReBEC record and published report both explicitly describe menstrual-fluid collection and immunoassay analysis.

title: Autologous PRP combined with menstrual-blood-derived stem cells for thin endometrium and Asherman syndrome
condition: Thin endometrium; Asherman syndrome / intrauterine adhesions
sponsor: Jinan Central Hospital Affiliated to Shandong University
technology: MenSC isolation/culture; PRP; hydrogel/scaffold; intrauterine transplantation
mf_relevance: Menstrual blood is collected by menstrual cup, MenSCs are isolated and expanded, then used alone or with PRP/scaffold for intrauterine treatment of endometrial injury.
notes: Registry explicitly describes menstrual-cup collection of menstrual blood and culture of autologous MenSCs before intrauterine transplantation.
